items.title: Bat Taking Flight
items.alt: A small chestnut bat launches upward from a short branch, wings raised in a deep V and hind feet just releasing the bark.
items.description: A small chestnut bat launches upward from a short branch, wings raised in a deep V and hind feet just releasing the bark. Useful for movement vocabulary.

items.title: Bat Banking in Flight
items.alt: A charcoal bat makes a clear banking turn, one wing tilted toward the viewer and the other extended behind, head looking into the turn.
items.description: A charcoal bat makes a clear banking turn, one wing tilted toward the viewer and the other extended behind, head looking into the turn. Useful for direction story cards.

items.title: Bat Hovering Beside a Flower
items.alt: A tawny bat hovers beside one large white night flower on a short leafy stem, muzzle directed toward the bloom and wings spread.
items.description: A tawny bat hovers beside one large white night flower on a short leafy stem, muzzle directed toward the bloom and wings spread. Useful for nature-themed learning.
